rules.masonry_blocks: Stone faces from blocks of 2 x 2 or 4 x 2 cubes in a running bond, one colour per block, one-cube inset darker mortar; no per-cube noise, no checkerboard.
rules.natural_rock: Rock never reads as a box, tower or slab with a flat front: a terraced, lopsided mass of large offset blocks with connected moss caps.
rules.real_scale: Real-world size unless the class states an exaggeration factor.
rules.game_light: Colours from the approved palette board; dark accents darker than on grey; no gloss on dark materials.

watchtower.desc: a timber watchtower on stone footings
watchtower.contract: Footprint at most 4 x 4 m. Platform floor at 7.0 m with a waist-high railing; a ladder on the front (-Y); four posts on stone footings that reach down to -1.0 m (foundation shows on slopes).

spearman.contract: Rest pose, arms straight down, the spear upright in the right fist through the grip cell; team colour on tunic and shield.
